decision: Display as SCORE (0-1), not a calibrated probability
why: Model was trained with class-weighted BCE loss (pos_weight) throughout this project to handle severe class imbalance -- this deliberately shifts sigmoid outputs away from true base rates as a side effect of improving class separation, so poor calibration here is an expected consequence of a design choice made correctly for a different goal (discrimination, not calibration), not a bug.
per_client_note: Per-client calibration is even less demonstrable than the pooled result above: Kenya has 36 test-period positives and Uganda has 17, both far below what would be needed for a per-client reliability curve with any bin resolution. The pooled result is the best-supported statement this data can make about calibration, and it applies (or fails to apply) to the whole system, not to any single client's number specifically.
